title: Spacecraft Fire Safety Experiment — I (SAFFIRE-I)
objectives: Measure growth and propagation of a large microgravity fire and compare low-gravity flammability limits with normal-gravity material screening tests.
approach: After Cygnus departed the ISS, ignite an approximately 0.94 m × 0.4 m cotton–fiberglass (SIBAL) panel inside a forced-flow duct, with air speed around 20 cm/s. Use two cameras plus thermal, radiative, pressure, oxygen, carbon-dioxide, and airflow sensors to observe the burn.
status_message: No data available for this investigation yet. Graphs cannot be generated.
